title: These are 100% POLYESTER
text: These are 100% POLYESTER. Don't be fooled by the "1500" in the name.. they aren't 1500-count sheets & they are 100% polyester (picture of tag included). They have more of a slip than cotton sheets - it's a completely different kind of softness. I'm surprised the rating is so high because to me, they're just ok which is why I rated them 3-stars (but my last set was $150 from BB&B). If you're used to luxurious sheets, I don't recommend. But for the price they're ok. I don't regret buying. Also, they DO wrinkle. After sleeping in them for a few days, I just checked & where I lay is all wrinkled.
